name: megascenes-fathers-day-song
description: Create an original Father's Day song with vocals for your dad or grandpa: his name, your memories together and what he means to you.

interface.longDescription:
Give the name to sing, a few memories to sing about and the style: country, classic rock, acoustic, blues or pop, with a male or female lead, a duet or a choir. You get an original Father's Day song with vocals as an audio file, with lyrics written from your memories or the lyrics you give. The voice sings the name you give.

ChatGPT tells you what the song needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The song plays in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the name and the details you want sung: no address or contact details are needed.

To play at a Father's Day barbecue, send in the family chat or add to a video for him.

Limitations: original songs; it does not imitate a real singer's voice or copy an existing song or artist. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Create Father's Day songs with vocals
Sing his name and your memories together
Return the audio in the chat
defaultPrompt: A country song for Dad about our fishing trips and his terrible jokes
A classic rock song for Papa Joe about fixing the old car together
An acoustic Father's Day ballad for my dad, sung as a duet

positive.prompt: A country Father's Day song for Dad about our fishing trips and his terrible jokes. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Father's Day song needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A classic rock Father's Day song for Papa Joe about fixing the old car together. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one song needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which song models can I use here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Father's Day song models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A blues Father's Day song for Dad about Saturday mornings in his workshop, with a male voice. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Press 200 vinyl records of my song and ship them to my store.
Send my song to my producer by email at sam@example.com.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
